in_sanskrit.name: Hadhansh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of Prosperity
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Hadhansh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Hadha’ (Lord) and ‘Ansh’ (Prosperity), Hadhansh refers to the Lord of Prosperity in Hindu mythology. This name is believed to bring wealth and abundance to the one who bears it.
